input.quote: 11.1 Upon expiry or termination for any reason, Vendor shall, at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six months at the rates in the expiring Order Form.
input.rationale: Section 11 fully satisfies the preferred position: 11.1 gives up to six months of transition assistance on Customer's request for any expiry or termination (at the expiring Order Form rates, which is better for us than then-current rates, and expressly covering knowledge transfer, export support, replacement-supplier cooperation and continued service levels); 11.2 requires return of all Customer Data within thirty days in a complete, commonly used, documented, machine-readable format and bars withholding for fee disputes; 11.3 requires secure deletion only after Customer confirms successful return, with written officer certification and protection of any legally required retained copy. Section 9 imposes no carve-out from these obligations, and Section 15 does not conflict. Section 11 operates by its own terms on expiry or termination, so no redline is needed.
